scope: Frozen physical HFSS S4 tiled as 64 independent 2x2 blocks plus the frozen nominal 256-port EEP pattern operator. This is a fixed-mask algorithmic feasibility oracle, not integrated 16x16 HFSS evidence.
next_action: Design one local x/y even-odd modal correction block against the trusted physical S4. Do not add another cascade stage.
limitations: The S256 matching operator is block diagonal and omits coupling between 2x2 cells.
The pattern operator is the frozen nominal EEP used by the scene package, not an EEP exported from the v1.39 differential geometry.
A solver_error is a failed search stage, not a mathematical proof of global infeasibility.
